taxonomy_gaps.osteofibroma: BTXRD class name; WHO ICD-O-3.1 lists Osteofibroma under ossifying fibroma M-9262/0 as a nomenclature/coding alias, but BTXRD's applied definition and per-case diagnosis are unverified; retain source label and provenance, do not silently relabel cases or infer pathology pending original protocol/specialist review
taxonomy_gaps.synovial_osteochondroma: Synovial chondromatosis review ingested under verified CC BY 4.0 and its synonym synovial osteochondromatosis is supported for the canonical entity; BTXRD label synovial osteochondroma remains unadjudicated and unsupported as an automatic mapping.

online_source_review.dataset_taxonomy_note: The original BTXRD paper lists both class names and describes multi-center inputs with differing confirmation pathways; class name presence alone does not establish uniform histopathology confirmation.
